label: Composite tray — cash-balance, office, auto, states, grouping, SEHI, energy, R&D
scenario: Synthetic tray packet for an S corporation operator. Household earned income is above the cash-balance floor, officer W-2 is not near zero, and the retirement deduction is zero. Self-employment income is zero. Form 8829 is present and is not a complete no-gap filing. There is a vehicle signal. W-2 boxes show more than one state, and the state returns are not in the packet. Form 8582 lists multiple activities and no current-year passive income. Schedule E losses have no hours log. SEHI is blank against premiums. Form 5695 and Form 6765 are in the packet. No home-ownership document and no children.
